short_description: Azure hosted inventory portal returns intermittent errors
description: The inventory portal loads normally at first but returns HTTP 502 errors several times an hour. Staff at two offices see the same behavior, while other internal websites remain available.
resolution_summary: Corrected an Azure Application Gateway backend health probe that was checking an obsolete application path. Verified that both backend instances remained healthy.

short_description: Overnight export cannot save files to Azure storage
description: The scheduled analytics export has failed to write its output to an Azure storage container for two nights. Interactive reporting still works, and the job log records an authorization failure during file upload.
resolution_summary: Renewed an expired storage access signature in the export job configuration and verified a successful upload.

short_description: Shipment tracking service repeatedly restarts
description: Shipment status updates are delayed in the internal tracking portal. The service dashboard shows repeated container restarts in the Azure Kubernetes Service cluster after the latest deployment, but no clear error appears in the portal.
resolution_summary: Raised the container memory limit after confirming memory termination events in Kubernetes. Verified stable pods and successful processing of the queued updates.

short_description: Azure Virtual Desktop session fails before desktop appears
description: Users selecting the warehouse desktop receive a message that no resources are available. Authentication completes successfully, and the issue affects everyone using this desktop pool this morning.
resolution_summary: Corrected a failed session host registration in the Azure Virtual Desktop host pool and restored the affected hosts to service. Verified new sessions could start.

short_description: Test environment virtual machine unavailable after reboot
description: A shared Azure virtual machine used for integration testing no longer responds after its scheduled reboot. Other machines in the same environment are reachable, and the Azure console shows the affected machine is running.
resolution_summary: Used Azure serial console access to correct an invalid filesystem mount entry that prevented normal boot. Restarted the machine and verified application availability.

short_description: Report downloads stall during peak processing
description: The reporting portal accepts requests but large downloads time out during the afternoon processing window. Smaller reports usually succeed, and users working from home and the office report the same delays.
resolution_summary: Identified sustained disk throughput limits on the Azure worker virtual machine. Increased the managed disk performance tier and verified large report downloads during a processing run.

short_description: New starter cannot sign in to internal services
description: A newly created test account cannot sign in to the staff portal or Microsoft Teams. Both show that access is blocked, although the account appears in the directory and its temporary password is accepted.
resolution_summary: Enabled the account in Microsoft Entra ID after confirming its onboarding status. Verified successful sign-in to both services.

short_description: Repeated authentication prompts after phone replacement
description: A staff member using a synthetic test account receives repeated verification prompts when opening Microsoft 365 applications after replacing their phone. Their password works, but they cannot complete the second authentication step.
resolution_summary: Removed the obsolete Microsoft Authenticator registration and completed a new multifactor authentication registration. Verified sign-in with the replacement device.

short_description: VPN sign-in rejected before connection starts
description: The VPN client rejects a pilot account immediately after the browser sign-in step. The account can open the staff portal, and another test account on the same laptop can connect through the VPN client.
resolution_summary: Restored the pilot account's membership in the Entra ID group authorized for the VPN enterprise application. Verified that application assignment and VPN authentication succeeded.

short_description: Procurement portal enters a sign-in loop
description: Opening the procurement portal redirects repeatedly between its login page and the organizational sign-in page. The issue began this morning for all pilot accounts, while other single sign-on applications remain accessible.
resolution_summary: Updated the procurement enterprise application's expired SAML signing certificate in coordination with the application configuration. Verified that a new sign-in completed without a redirect loop.

short_description: Azure Virtual Desktop access blocked at sign-in
description: Several pilot accounts receive an access policy error before reaching the Azure Virtual Desktop resource list. The same accounts can access email, and affected users report the problem from compliant managed laptops.
resolution_summary: Corrected the scope of a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policy that unintentionally blocked the desktop pilot accounts. Verified successful access from compliant managed devices.

short_description: Approved project members cannot open shared workspace
description: Two test accounts added to a project yesterday still receive access denied when opening the project workspace. Existing members can open it, and the new accounts can access other workspaces normally.
resolution_summary: Corrected a dynamic membership rule in the Entra ID group granting workspace access. Confirmed group membership processing and verified access for both accounts.

short_description: VPN connects but internal sites do not load
description: Remote users can establish a VPN session and access public websites, but internal sites time out. The issue affects multiple managed devices and began after the overnight maintenance window.
resolution_summary: Restored a missing internal subnet route in the VPN gateway configuration. Verified access to the affected internal sites through a remote connection.

short_description: Office users cannot reach the service portal by name
description: The service portal opens from home but fails to load by its normal hostname at one office. Other external websites work, and several workstations in that office show the same behavior.
resolution_summary: Corrected a stale record on the office DNS resolver and cleared its cached response. Verified that the portal hostname resolved to the current address.

short_description: Teams calls break up on one office floor
description: Microsoft Teams calls on the third floor have choppy audio and intermittent frozen video. The same laptops work normally on other floors, and wired users on the affected floor report similar call quality problems.
resolution_summary: Replaced a faulty switch uplink module that was causing packet loss. Confirmed normal link error counters and stable Teams calls on the affected floor.

short_description: Branch users lose access to hosted order application
description: The order application times out for everyone in one branch while other locations can still use it. General internet access at the branch is working, and the issue started shortly after scheduled firewall maintenance.
resolution_summary: Restored a firewall rule allowing the branch subnet to reach the hosted application's HTTPS endpoint. Verified successful connections from the branch.

short_description: Wireless devices repeatedly disconnect in training rooms
description: Managed laptops disconnect from the wireless network every few minutes in two training rooms. Reconnecting works briefly, and the same devices remain connected in the main office area.
resolution_summary: Resolved overlapping channel assignments and excessive interference on the training room wireless access points. Verified stable connectivity during a full training session.

short_description: Desktop sessions freeze during busy office hours
description: Azure Virtual Desktop sessions become unresponsive for several seconds at a time from one office during late morning. Home users on the same desktop pool do not report the issue, and office users also notice slow file transfers.
resolution_summary: Adjusted traffic prioritization and removed an unintended bandwidth cap on the office WAN circuit. Verified stable desktop sessions while file transfers were active.

short_description: One laptop cannot open the VPN client
description: The VPN client closes immediately when launched on a managed laptop. Other applications work, and another laptop using the same test account can start the VPN client and connect successfully.
resolution_summary: Repaired the damaged VPN client installation and restarted its local service. Verified that the client launched and established a connection.

short_description: Teams microphone unavailable on a managed laptop
description: Microsoft Teams reports that no microphone is available on one laptop even though the headset works on another device. Restarting Teams and joining a different meeting do not change the result.
resolution_summary: Enabled microphone access in the device privacy settings and reinstalled the headset driver. Verified audio capture in a Teams test call.

short_description: Virtual desktop client shows a blank window
description: The Azure Virtual Desktop client displays a blank window on one workstation after an update. The same test account can open its desktop through a browser and from another workstation.
resolution_summary: Cleared the local desktop client cache and repaired the client installation. Verified that the workspace feed and desktop session opened normally.

short_description: Documents remain queued on one workstation
description: Print jobs from one workstation remain in the local queue and never reach the shared printer. Other workstations can print to that printer, and the affected device has the same problem from several applications.
resolution_summary: Cleared a blocked local print spooler queue and reinstalled the approved printer driver. Verified printing from two applications.

short_description: Workstation becomes slow shortly after sign-in
description: A managed workstation takes several minutes to open applications after each sign-in. The issue affects all test accounts on that device, while nearby workstations running the same applications remain responsive.
resolution_summary: Removed obsolete local update cache files that had exhausted disk space and completed pending updates. Verified normal application startup after a restart.

short_description: External monitors remain blank after docking
description: A laptop detects its docking station but both external monitors remain blank. The laptop screen works, and the monitors display correctly when connected to a different laptop using the same dock.
resolution_summary: Updated the laptop graphics driver and docking station firmware to the approved compatible versions. Verified both external displays after docking and rebooting.

short_description: Teams channel messages fail for all channel members
description: Members of one Microsoft Teams channel cannot post new messages and see a notice that the channel is read-only. Other channels in the same team work, and the behavior is consistent on desktop and web clients.
resolution_summary: Removed an unintended channel moderation restriction that prevented members from posting. Verified new messages from a standard member account.

short_description: Meeting room calendar rejects new reservations
description: A shared meeting room declines all new bookings even when its calendar shows free time. The problem occurs for several organizers, while booking other rooms works normally.
resolution_summary: Corrected the room mailbox booking policy that had restricted the booking window to zero days. Verified that an available reservation was accepted.

short_description: Shared mailbox no longer receives external messages
description: External test messages to the shared purchasing mailbox are rejected, while messages from internal accounts arrive normally. Other shared mailboxes can receive external mail without an issue.
resolution_summary: Removed an unintended internal-senders-only delivery restriction on the Exchange Online shared mailbox. Verified delivery from an external synthetic test sender.

short_description: SharePoint library opens but documents cannot be uploaded
description: Project members can read files in a SharePoint document library but new uploads fail with a storage message. The issue occurs in the browser and through synchronization, while other project sites accept uploads.
resolution_summary: Increased the affected SharePoint site's storage quota within the allocated tenant capacity. Verified document uploads through the browser and synchronization client.

short_description: Teams meeting invitations lack a join link
description: New meetings created through a shared scheduling calendar do not include a Teams join link. Existing online meetings still work, and the issue occurs for all delegates using that calendar.
resolution_summary: Corrected the online meeting policy for the licensed scheduling account and refreshed its calendar integration. Verified a new invitation contained a working Teams join link.

short_description: Departed project site still appears read-only for members
description: A project site reopened for a new work phase remains read-only for every member. Members can open its files but cannot edit pages or documents, including through the web interface.
resolution_summary: Removed the archived SharePoint site's read-only lock after confirming the approved reopening request. Verified document editing and page updates.

short_description: Purchase orders fail at final approval
description: Approvers can review purchase orders in the procurement application but receive a validation error when submitting final approval. Draft creation works, and the problem affects orders using a newly introduced cost center.
resolution_summary: Added the missing cost center mapping to the procurement approval workflow configuration. Verified approval of a synthetic order using the new cost center.

short_description: Expense application reports duplicate submissions
description: The expense application rejects new claims as duplicates even when the reference number has not been used. Several pilot accounts see the issue after the latest application release, while previously saved claims remain viewable.
resolution_summary: Corrected the claim reference generation logic introduced by the release and deployed the application fix. Verified that distinct synthetic claims received unique references.

short_description: Customer portal sign-in succeeds but dashboard fails
description: Test users can sign in to the customer service portal but see an application error instead of their dashboard. The problem affects accounts linked to one synthetic account category, while other test accounts load normally.
resolution_summary: Corrected the portal dashboard query to handle an empty optional category field. Verified dashboard rendering for affected and unaffected synthetic account categories.

short_description: Inventory screen shows outdated stock quantities
description: The inventory application displays yesterday's stock quantities although today's warehouse transactions are visible in the transaction list. Refreshing the page and using a different workstation show the same outdated totals.
resolution_summary: Restarted a stalled application aggregation job after correcting its invalid processing checkpoint. Rebuilt the stock summary and verified it matched the synthetic transaction records.

short_description: Monthly finance report omits one business unit
description: The monthly finance report completes without an error but leaves out one synthetic business unit. The underlying entries are visible in the finance application, and reports for earlier months include that unit.
resolution_summary: Updated the reporting configuration to include the business unit's new organizational code. Regenerated the monthly report and reconciled its totals against synthetic source entries.

short_description: Order entry page freezes when adding a product
description: The order entry page stops responding when a particular synthetic product is added to an order. Other products work, and the issue can be reproduced in multiple browsers by different test accounts.
resolution_summary: Corrected an invalid unit conversion rule in the application's product configuration. Verified the affected product could be added and the order saved.

short_description: Virtual desktop opens with a temporary user profile
description: A pilot user receives a temporary profile on Azure Virtual Desktop and cannot see their saved desktop settings. The session log reports that the FSLogix profile container is already in use. Other users on the same host can load their profiles.
resolution_summary: Confirmed an abandoned session on a second host was holding the profile container open. Signed out the stale session and verified that the user's normal profile attached on reconnect.

short_description: No virtual desktops available after the evening shutdown
description: Early-shift users can see their Azure Virtual Desktop workspace but cannot launch a session before the main office opens. The host pool has no available hosts during that period, while existing sessions from the previous shift continue normally.
resolution_summary: Corrected the scaling plan's time zone and ramp-up schedule. Verified that sufficient session hosts started before the early shift and accepted new sessions.

short_description: Applications lag for everyone on one virtual desktop host
description: Users assigned to one Azure Virtual Desktop session host report slow typing and long application launches. Sessions on other hosts in the same pool are responsive, including from the same office. The affected host shows sustained CPU saturation.
resolution_summary: Found a stuck background indexing process on the affected host. Drained and restarted the host, corrected the indexing schedule in the image, and verified normal session responsiveness.

short_description: New Kubernetes deployment cannot download its container image
description: A service update in Azure Kubernetes Service leaves the new pods waiting with image download errors. Existing replicas still answer requests, and the same image tag is visible in the private container registry. The pod events include an authorization rejection.
resolution_summary: Restored the cluster kubelet identity's image-pull role on the Azure container registry. Verified that the new replicas downloaded the image and completed the rollout.

short_description: Kubernetes workload remains pending after a node pool upgrade
description: Several internal processing pods in Azure Kubernetes Service remain pending after a node pool replacement. Other namespaces are running, and the pending pods have no application logs. Scheduling events report that no available nodes match their placement requirements.
resolution_summary: Updated the workload's node selector to match the replacement pool's approved labels. Verified pod scheduling and successful processing without changing the application image.

short_description: Application unavailable during Kubernetes rollout despite running pods
description: A hosted lookup service returns service unavailable during a rollout in Azure Kubernetes Service. The new pods are running without restarts, but none are marked ready. Direct checks against the container's documented health endpoint succeed.
resolution_summary: Corrected the readiness probe port in the deployment manifest. Confirmed that the pods became ready and the service endpoint resumed routing requests to them.

short_description: Custom hostname on Azure web application shows a certificate warning
description: All browsers warn that the certificate for an Azure App Service application's custom hostname has expired. The default service hostname opens normally and the application responds after the warning is bypassed in an isolated test. Other hosted sites are unaffected.
resolution_summary: Renewed the approved TLS certificate and updated the custom hostname binding. Verified a valid certificate chain and normal HTTPS access without bypassing browser checks.

short_description: Azure web application takes a minute to answer the first request
description: An Azure App Service application responds quickly once in use but the first request after a quiet period times out. Application logs show a full startup sequence at each occurrence. The delay is seen from multiple locations and disappears during continuous traffic.
resolution_summary: Enabled Always On on the supported hosting plan and configured an application warm-up endpoint. Verified that requests remained responsive after an idle period.

short_description: Azure virtual machine backups fail while the machine remains usable
description: Scheduled backups of one Azure virtual machine have failed for three days. The hosted application is available and disk space is sufficient. Backup job details show that the guest snapshot extension does not respond, while other machines in the vault back up successfully.
resolution_summary: Repaired the guest agent and reinstalled the backup snapshot extension. Ran an on-demand backup and verified a successful recovery point and test file restore.

short_description: Remote administration of an Azure server fails after log growth
description: A Windows server hosted on an Azure virtual machine stops accepting remote administration connections. Its console is reachable and shows almost no free space on the operating system volume. Other servers on the same subnet remain accessible.
resolution_summary: Archived excessive platform diagnostic logs under the retention policy and expanded the operating system disk. Verified free space, remote access, and the hosted service after a restart.

short_description: Azure blob uploads retry repeatedly during an import window
description: Several independent import workers receive server-busy responses while writing to the same Azure storage account. Reads outside the import window work, and storage metrics show request throttling during the burst. The worker software has not changed.
resolution_summary: Staggered the worker schedules and enabled bounded exponential retry in the shared ingestion configuration. Verified that the next import completed within the storage account's request limits.

short_description: Azure file share cannot be reached from a newly peered virtual network
description: Two newly deployed Azure worker machines cannot mount the shared Azure Files path. Older workers can still mount it, and the new machines resolve the storage hostname differently. General outbound connectivity and credentials checks succeed.
resolution_summary: Linked the storage private DNS zone to the new virtual network and verified private endpoint resolution. Confirmed that both worker machines could mount and read the share.

short_description: Scheduled Azure function has stopped triggering
description: An Azure Functions housekeeping job has produced no scheduled invocations since a configuration deployment. An authorized test invocation completes successfully, but the host log reports an invalid timer schedule. Other functions in the application still trigger.
resolution_summary: Corrected the timer expression in the function application's deployment settings. Verified scheduled invocations over two cycles and confirmed that the missed housekeeping tasks were completed safely.

short_description: Multiple application workers encounter Azure SQL resource errors
description: Several application workers intermittently fail database requests against the same Azure SQL database during the daily consolidation. The database metrics reach the configured compute limit, while request latency is normal before and after the batch. No authentication failures are recorded.
resolution_summary: Raised the database compute tier within the approved capacity allocation and scheduled the consolidation outside peak traffic. Verified resource headroom and successful worker requests during a full batch.

short_description: Test account cannot use its registered security key
description: A test account's password is accepted but its security key is rejected at the organizational sign-in page for every application. The key works with another registered test account. The affected account recently completed an authentication-method migration.
resolution_summary: Removed an incomplete security key registration and registered the key again using the approved recovery process. Verified successful multifactor sign-in to two enterprise applications.

short_description: Application account remains disabled after approved onboarding
description: A new test user can authenticate through single sign-on but receives an account inactive message inside the training service. The provisioning dashboard records repeated failures for that user, while existing users can access the service from the same devices.
resolution_summary: Corrected the provisioning attribute mapping for the account's active status and reran provisioning. Verified that the target account was enabled and accessible through single sign-on.

short_description: Account is blocked following a sign-in risk alert
description: A pilot account is denied access to several enterprise applications from both office and home connections. The organizational sign-in page requests additional account remediation. Other accounts on the same managed device work, and the directory shows an unresolved risk event.
resolution_summary: Reviewed the synthetic risk event under the account recovery procedure, reset the affected credentials, and completed risk remediation. Verified normal access and checked that the old credentials no longer worked.

short_description: New password works on the office domain but not in cloud applications
description: After a test user changes their password on the office domain, the new password works on a domain workstation but is rejected by Microsoft 365. Other users can sign in normally. Directory synchronization monitoring shows password synchronization failures for the affected domain connector.
resolution_summary: Restored the connector's password synchronization permissions and resumed synchronization. Verified that the new password worked for both domain and cloud authentication.

short_description: Single sign-on fails only for a new service URL
description: The knowledge portal's new URL rejects all federated sign-ins with an assertion validation error. The original URL and other enterprise applications work for the same test accounts. The failure occurs immediately after the identity provider returns the user to the portal.
resolution_summary: Aligned the enterprise application's audience identifier and reply URL with the approved portal configuration. Verified new sign-ins through the new URL and retired the obsolete endpoint.

short_description: One account repeatedly receives session expired across web applications
description: One test user must sign in again every few minutes in several browser-based enterprise applications, including on a spare managed laptop. Other users retain normal sessions. Directory audit events show repeated session revocation for the affected account.
resolution_summary: Corrected an account maintenance automation rule that repeatedly revoked the pilot user's sessions. Verified normal session lifetimes and retained the intended revocation behavior for disabled test accounts.

short_description: Guest user reaches the wrong organization during sign-in
description: An invited synthetic guest account cannot open the partner workspace and is told the account does not exist in the selected directory. Internal members can open the workspace. The guest can authenticate to their home directory but has never completed the invitation flow.
resolution_summary: Reset the guest invitation redemption state and completed redemption against the intended home identity. Verified access to the approved workspace without creating an additional guest account.

short_description: Managed device is rejected by access policy after re-enrollment
description: A re-enrolled test laptop is blocked from several protected web applications with a device compliance requirement. Management reports the current device as compliant, but the sign-in record references an older device identifier. Other managed laptops using the same account work.
resolution_summary: Removed the obsolete directory device registration and refreshed the current device's authentication registration. Verified that sign-ins referenced the compliant device and satisfied the existing access policy.

short_description: Virtual desktop workspace is missing for newly approved pilot users
description: Recently approved pilot users can sign in to the Azure Virtual Desktop client but see no published desktop. Existing pilot users see the workspace on the same devices. The affected accounts can access unrelated organizational services without errors.
resolution_summary: Assigned the approved access group to the desktop application group and verified the new users' effective memberships. Refreshed their feeds and confirmed that the published desktop appeared.

short_description: VPN browser authentication asks for administrator approval
description: A VPN pilot cohort encounters an administrator approval request during the browser authentication step and cannot establish a tunnel. The client launches normally and the accounts can sign in to other services. Previously authorized VPN users are unaffected.
resolution_summary: Reviewed the VPN enterprise application's requested permissions and granted the approved tenant consent. Verified successful authentication for the pilot cohort without relaxing user consent policy.

short_description: Directory group change does not reach connected application
description: A synthetic support account was approved for a new application role but still receives its previous permissions after signing out and back in. The directory group shows the expected membership, while the provisioning log records a failed update to the target application.
resolution_summary: Renewed the expired provisioning connector credential and retried the failed group update. Verified the target application's membership and the account's new role.

short_description: Password reset portal offers no usable verification method
description: A test user who has forgotten their password cannot complete self-service password reset. The portal offers only a retired phone number, and the account has no accessible alternate method. Other test users can complete the reset process.
resolution_summary: Verified the account through the approved recovery procedure, reset its password, and registered current recovery methods. Confirmed that a subsequent self-service reset could complete.

short_description: Approved application administrator receives insufficient privileges
description: A synthetic administrator can open the directory management portal but cannot perform an approved application configuration task. The role appears as eligible rather than active, and no privileged activation event is present. Standard sign-in and read access work.
resolution_summary: Completed the approved time-limited privileged role activation and verified the required application management permission. Confirmed that the elevated access expired at the end of the activation window.

short_description: Service account authentication fails after credential rotation
description: A scheduled integration cannot obtain an access token after its service account credential rotation. Directory logs report invalid client authentication before the target API is contacted. Interactive test users can still use the target service.
resolution_summary: Corrected the credential reference for the application's directory identity and retired the obsolete secret. Verified token acquisition and a successful integration run without exposing credential values in logs.

short_description: VPN connection drops at regular intervals for a remote cohort
description: Users connecting through one VPN gateway lose their tunnels roughly once an hour and must reconnect. Wired internet remains available, and the same devices stay connected through a second gateway. Gateway logs show failures during tunnel key renewal.
resolution_summary: Aligned the tunnel rekey settings on the affected gateway and its peer. Verified uninterrupted sessions through two renewal cycles and confirmed that the alternate gateway remained healthy.

short_description: Internal file server names fail only through the VPN
description: Remote users can reach an internal file server by address after connecting to VPN but cannot resolve its hostname. Office users resolve it normally. The VPN client shows public DNS servers rather than the internal resolver addresses.
resolution_summary: Corrected the VPN connection profile's DNS server distribution and internal name suffix settings. Verified hostname resolution and file access after reconnecting a remote test device.

short_description: Wireless laptops connect but cannot reach anything outside their subnet
description: Laptops joining the visitor training wireless network receive addresses and can reach the local gateway but cannot open any external or internal website. Wired devices work. The fault affects multiple laptop models and test accounts.
resolution_summary: Restored the routed uplink for the training wireless VLAN after a switch configuration change. Verified the intended permitted destinations and confirmed that restricted internal destinations remained blocked.

short_description: Teams media fails while messaging works at a branch
description: Teams chat and calendar work at one branch, but meetings have no audio or video on multiple wired and wireless devices. Calls work for those devices on a separate internet connection. Firewall logs show denied outbound media traffic during test calls.
resolution_summary: Updated the branch firewall's approved Teams media rules and verified outbound UDP connectivity. Confirmed successful calls and screen sharing without broadening unrelated network access.

short_description: Remote desktop disconnects when users roam between office access points
description: Azure Virtual Desktop sessions disconnect briefly when users walk between two office areas. Sessions remain stable at a desk and from home. Wireless controller events show repeated full authentication during roaming between the affected access points.
resolution_summary: Aligned the access points' roaming settings and authentication configuration within the wireless mobility domain. Verified uninterrupted desktop sessions while moving between the office areas.

short_description: Office cannot reach an internal service following a subnet change
description: All workstations in a relocated department time out when connecting to an internal scheduling service. Other departments can still use it and the relocated devices reach other internal services. Connection attempts leave the new subnet but receive no replies.
resolution_summary: Added the approved return route for the relocated subnet on the service-side router. Verified bidirectional connectivity and access from the relocated department.

short_description: New workstation has no network link on an assigned desk port
description: A newly imaged workstation reports its Ethernet cable is disconnected at one desk. The same cable and workstation connect at a nearby desk, and a second device also fails on the original port. The access switch records that port as disabled.
resolution_summary: Confirmed the desk port's approved use and enabled it with the correct access VLAN configuration. Verified link negotiation and expected network access from the workstation.

short_description: Internal hostname resolves intermittently to an old service address
description: Users across several offices sometimes reach a retired service page when opening the same internal hostname. Repeated lookups against different internal DNS servers return different addresses. Direct access to the current endpoint is consistent.
resolution_summary: Repaired replication for the affected internal DNS zone and removed the obsolete record from the secondary server. Verified consistent answers from all internal resolvers after cache expiry.

short_description: Large HTTPS responses fail through the branch security gateway
description: Users at one branch can open simple pages in an internal portal but larger responses end with connection resets. The same requests work elsewhere. The branch security gateway records inspection errors for those transactions, while the portal logs successful responses.
resolution_summary: Updated the gateway's content inspection software and applied the approved compatibility setting for the portal. Verified large responses and retained inspection for other traffic.

short_description: Secure wireless onboarding fails for every newly enrolled device
description: Newly enrolled managed laptops cannot join the corporate wireless network, although existing devices connect and the new laptops work over Ethernet. Authentication server logs reject the new device certificate chain. The issue affects several test users.
resolution_summary: Added the approved issuing certificate chain to the wireless authentication server's trust configuration. Verified certificate-based wireless authentication for new and existing devices.

short_description: Monitoring traffic saturates the office uplink each morning
description: Video calls and remote desktop sessions become slow throughout an office at the same time each morning. Link utilization rises sharply even before most staff arrive. Flow monitoring shows a large scheduled transfer to a management collector.
resolution_summary: Rescheduled the bulk transfer and applied its approved traffic rate limit at the office edge. Verified usable bandwidth and stable interactive sessions during the next transfer.

short_description: Internal web portal is unreachable over IPv6 at one location
description: Browsers at one location wait before opening an internal portal, while forcing an IPv4 connection succeeds immediately. The hostname publishes both address families and other locations use either successfully. IPv6 connection attempts from the affected location do not reach the server.
resolution_summary: Corrected the site's IPv6 route advertisement and upstream routing entry. Verified successful IPv4 and IPv6 connections without removing the portal's address records.

short_description: One VPN gateway refuses new tunnels under moderate load
description: Remote users assigned to one gateway receive a connection capacity error before tunnel establishment. Another gateway accepts the same accounts and devices. The affected gateway lists many sessions whose clients have already disconnected.
resolution_summary: Cleared confirmed stale tunnels during an approved maintenance window and corrected idle-session cleanup settings. Verified new connections and stable session counts under normal load.

short_description: Branch connection fails after circuit failover
description: After a primary circuit outage, a branch retains internet access through its backup circuit but cannot reach hosted internal services. Other branches remain connected. The backup link is active, but its site-to-site tunnel does not establish.
resolution_summary: Updated the peer configuration to permit the approved backup circuit address and reestablished the tunnel. Verified internal connectivity over the backup circuit and tested restoration to the primary link.

short_description: Remote desktop opens but the local printer is not listed
description: One workstation's printer is missing inside Azure Virtual Desktop, although local printing works. The same test account sees a redirected printer from another workstation. Other redirected devices appear normally in the affected workstation's session.
resolution_summary: Enabled printer redirection in the local desktop client's connection settings and repaired the local print driver package. Verified the redirected printer and a test print within the session.

short_description: Virtual desktop disconnects only when a USB headset is attached
description: The desktop client closes on one laptop when a USB headset is attached during an Azure Virtual Desktop session. Browser-based sessions and local audio work. A second laptop with the same account and headset does not reproduce the failure.
resolution_summary: Updated the local desktop client and its USB audio driver to the approved compatible versions. Verified headset attachment and removal during an active session without client termination.

short_description: VPN client cannot create its virtual network adapter
description: The VPN client on one managed laptop starts but fails before the authentication window with an adapter initialization error. Another account on the same device sees the same error. The laptop's physical network connection and browser access work.
resolution_summary: Removed an obsolete virtual adapter driver and repaired the VPN client's adapter installation. Verified a successful connection and internal access after restarting the laptop.

short_description: Teams desktop crashes while the browser client works
description: Teams closes immediately after displaying its splash screen on one workstation. The affected account can use Teams in a browser and on another workstation. Local application events show a failure loading a client runtime component.
resolution_summary: Repaired the supported WebView runtime and reinstalled the approved Teams client package. Verified client startup, chat, and meeting join on the workstation.

short_description: Outlook desktop search omits recent messages on one laptop
description: A test user can find recent messages through Outlook on the web but not through desktop search on one laptop. The messages are visible in desktop folders and other laptops return them in search. Local indexing status has not advanced overnight.
resolution_summary: Rebuilt the local search index after repairing the Outlook indexing integration. Verified that desktop searches returned both recent and older messages after indexing completed.

short_description: OneDrive repeatedly reports a local synchronization database error
description: One managed workstation cannot synchronize any of its approved document libraries. Browser uploads work and the same test account synchronizes successfully on a spare machine. The local client reports an unreadable synchronization database rather than a remote access error.
resolution_summary: Reset the local OneDrive synchronization state after safeguarding unsynchronized files. Reconnected the approved libraries and verified upload and download without losing local changes.

short_description: Laptop loses Ethernet after waking from sleep
description: One laptop's wired connection remains disconnected after resume until the network adapter is disabled and enabled. Wireless continues working, and other laptops on the same desk cable are unaffected. The local event log records adapter power transition failures.
resolution_summary: Installed the approved Ethernet driver update and corrected the adapter's device power management setting. Verified repeated sleep and resume cycles with working wired connectivity.

short_description: PDF printing produces unreadable symbols on one workstation
description: PDF files print as symbols from several applications on one workstation, while documents from other workstations print correctly on the same shared printer. The affected files display normally and can be printed correctly from a spare workstation.
resolution_summary: Replaced the incompatible local printer driver with the approved package and removed stale driver settings. Verified PDF and office document printing to the shared printer.

short_description: Managed laptop cannot complete its operating system update
description: One laptop repeatedly rolls back the same Windows quality update and displays a component store error. Other devices receive the update normally. The laptop has adequate free space and downloads the update successfully before installation fails.
resolution_summary: Repaired the local component store using an approved repair source and reran the update. Verified successful installation and a clean restart without rollback.

short_description: Spreadsheet application crashes for every account on one desktop
description: The spreadsheet application closes when opening even a new blank workbook on one desktop. The same accounts and workbooks work on other devices. Starting the application without locally installed add-ins succeeds.
resolution_summary: Removed an incompatible desktop add-in and installed its approved replacement. Verified normal workbook creation and opening with the remaining required add-ins enabled.

short_description: Web applications fail only in one managed browser profile
description: Several internal web applications show script errors in one browser profile on a laptop. A fresh profile on the same device works, as do other browsers. The errors occur only when a locally installed extension is active.
resolution_summary: Removed the conflicting extension from the affected profile under the approved browser policy and refreshed the profile settings. Verified the affected applications and retained required security extensions.

short_description: Encrypted laptop asks for recovery after firmware maintenance
description: A managed test laptop enters disk recovery on each startup after approved firmware maintenance. No recovery prompt occurs on other devices and the disk reports no hardware errors. A successful authorized recovery allows normal applications to run until the next restart.
resolution_summary: Used the approved recovery key process, verified firmware integrity and boot settings, and resealed the encryption protectors to the current platform state. Confirmed normal protected startup over two restarts.

short_description: Keyboard characters are incorrect inside a remote session
description: One workstation types unexpected symbols in Azure Virtual Desktop, while its local text editor uses the intended layout. The same account has the correct layout when connecting from a spare workstation. The issue starts with every new session from the affected client.
resolution_summary: Corrected the local remote desktop client's keyboard layout selection and removed an obsolete per-connection layout override. Verified the expected characters locally and inside new sessions.

short_description: Line-of-business desktop client fails to start after an update
description: An installed desktop client fails with a missing runtime message on several laptops in one software deployment ring. The application's web interface and the previous desktop version work. The affected laptops have the same newly deployed package revision.
resolution_summary: Corrected the managed installation package to include its approved runtime prerequisite and redeployed it to the affected ring. Verified client launch and a synthetic transaction before wider rollout.

short_description: Distribution list rejects messages from an approved sender
description: One synthetic distribution list returns a delivery rejection when an authorized internal test sender posts to it. Direct messages to members arrive normally, and the behavior is identical from web and desktop mail. Other list owners can post successfully.
resolution_summary: Corrected the distribution list's permitted-senders configuration and verified the approved sender's membership. Confirmed delivery to the list while retaining its restrictions for unauthorized senders.

short_description: Delegate can read a shared mailbox but cannot send as it
description: Two delegates can open a shared mailbox and read messages but receive a send-as permission error when sending from its address. The error occurs in Outlook on the web as well as desktop Outlook. Sending from their own addresses works.
resolution_summary: Granted the approved Send As permission on the shared mailbox in addition to existing Full Access. Verified outgoing messages displayed the shared address after permission propagation.

short_description: Room mailbox allows overlapping reservations
description: A test meeting room accepts two invitations for overlapping times even though neither organizer has exceptional booking rights. Both meetings appear as accepted in the room's web calendar. Other room mailboxes reject conflicting invitations correctly.
resolution_summary: Corrected the affected resource mailbox's conflict-handling settings. Reconciled the synthetic conflicting bookings and verified that a new overlapping invitation was declined.

short_description: External meeting participants remain in the lobby indefinitely
description: External test attendees cannot enter meetings organized by one pilot cohort without an organizer manually admitting them. Internal attendees join normally. The behavior occurs from different networks and clients and follows the meeting organizer rather than the attendee device.
resolution_summary: Corrected the cohort's assigned Teams meeting policy to match the approved external attendee lobby behavior. Verified a newly scheduled meeting with internal and external test participants.

short_description: Teams meeting recordings no longer appear for organizers
description: Meetings organized by a licensed pilot account complete normally but recording is unavailable in every client. Other organizers in the same meeting can create recordings. The affected account's meeting options show recording disabled even for newly scheduled meetings.
resolution_summary: Restored the approved recording permission in the organizer's Teams meeting policy and verified policy propagation. Confirmed recording creation and access through the expected storage location.

short_description: Teams channel tab fails for every member after a site move
description: A document tab in one Teams channel shows a location not found error for all members. Opening the library directly at its new SharePoint address works, and channel conversations are unaffected. The tab still displays the former site location.
resolution_summary: Updated the channel's document tab to reference the moved library and verified member access through Teams web and desktop clients. Removed the obsolete tab reference.

short_description: SharePoint document changes remain invisible to readers
description: Editors can see their latest changes to a SharePoint policy document but readers continue to see the previous version. The behavior is consistent across browsers and accounts. The library shows the new version as awaiting approval.
resolution_summary: Restored the library's approved content approval process and completed approval of the synthetic document revision. Verified that readers could see the published version while drafts remained restricted.

short_description: SharePoint files stay checked out after a project handover
description: Several documents in a shared library cannot be edited by any current project member. The browser reports that they are checked out to a retired synthetic project account. Unaffected files in the same library remain editable and storage is available.
resolution_summary: Recovered the checked-out files under the approved library administration process and checked in the preserved changes. Verified editing by current members and confirmed document version history remained available.

short_description: SharePoint folder synchronization fails on long nested paths
description: Members can edit a deeply nested library folder in the browser but synchronization reports path length errors on several managed devices. Shorter paths in the same library synchronize normally, and the issue follows the folder rather than a user or device.
resolution_summary: Shortened the affected library folder hierarchy with the content owner's approval and updated its shared navigation links. Verified successful synchronization of the reorganized synthetic documents.

short_description: External sharing link is rejected for all project guests
description: Guest test accounts can open the project site's landing page but a newly generated document sharing link reports that the sharing setting does not permit access. Internal members can open the document. The same behavior occurs for multiple invited guests and clients.
resolution_summary: Aligned the site's external sharing setting and the link type with the approved project sharing policy. Reissued the link to the authorized guest cohort and verified access without enabling anonymous sharing.

short_description: Mailbox stops sending after reaching its storage limit
description: A test mailbox can read existing mail but new outgoing messages fail in both web and desktop clients with a mailbox capacity warning. Other mailboxes send normally. The mailbox reports that its primary storage has reached the sending limit.
resolution_summary: Enabled the approved archive configuration and moved eligible synthetic mail under the retention policy. Verified reduced primary mailbox usage and successful send and receive operations.

short_description: Legitimate test mail is repeatedly held for moderation
description: Messages to a shared project address wait for approval even when sent by established internal members. The moderation queue contains the test messages, and there are no transport connectivity errors. The configured approver is a retired synthetic mailbox.
resolution_summary: Updated the shared recipient's approved moderators and sender exceptions. Processed the queued synthetic messages and verified that normal internal posts followed the intended delivery policy.

short_description: Mobile and web calendars show different availability from a room display
description: The web and mobile calendars agree on a room's reservations, but its Teams room display shows stale bookings throughout the day. The room account can sign in and join calls. Exchange diagnostics show repeated calendar access rejections for the device account.
resolution_summary: Restored the room account's approved mailbox calendar access configuration and refreshed the room service session. Verified that new and changed bookings appeared on the display.

short_description: Shared calendar delegates cannot update meetings they created
description: Delegates can view an executive test calendar but cannot change meeting times or cancel appointments through either web or desktop Outlook. The calendar owner can make the changes. The problem began after the calendar's delegate settings were reorganized.
resolution_summary: Restored the delegates' approved editor permissions and meeting request handling settings on the mailbox calendar. Verified creation, updates, and cancellation of a synthetic meeting by a delegate.

short_description: Procurement workflow sends approvals to the wrong supervisor
description: Purchase requests from one synthetic department appear in an unrelated supervisor's approval queue. Requesters can submit normally and other departments route correctly. The procurement audit trail shows the unexpected approver selected before notification messages are sent.
resolution_summary: Corrected the department-to-approver mapping in the procurement workflow and reassigned the pending synthetic requests. Verified routing with a new request and checked unaffected departments.

short_description: Purchase order cannot move beyond a valid delivery date
description: The purchasing application rejects delivery dates on a newly introduced regional holiday with an invalid working day message. The regional configuration should permit that date for the pilot warehouse. Multiple users reproduce the rejection while other dates save normally.
resolution_summary: Corrected the pilot warehouse's assigned business calendar in the application configuration. Verified accepted delivery dates against the approved regional calendar and retained the intended closed dates.

short_description: Expense totals change after a foreign currency claim is reopened
description: A saved synthetic expense claim shows a different reimbursement total when reopened without edits. It affects one foreign currency and reproduces across devices. The application calculation details show different exchange rate dates on save and read.
resolution_summary: Corrected the application's rate-date selection so a saved claim consistently uses its transaction-date rate. Recalculated the affected synthetic claims and verified stable totals after reopening.

short_description: Expense attachment uploads fail for otherwise valid claims
description: Users can save expense lines but attaching a PDF receipt fails with an application document-type validation message. The same file can be uploaded to the separate document portal, and the expense error occurs before a storage request is recorded. Image attachments work.
resolution_summary: Restored the allowed PDF media type in the expense application's attachment validation configuration. Verified PDF and image receipts and confirmed that disallowed file types remained blocked.

short_description: Inventory transfer appears twice in the warehouse summary
description: One synthetic warehouse transfer appears twice in the inventory application's summary even though its source transaction exists only once. Multiple accounts see the same totals. The application import audit shows the same source event processed after a retry.
resolution_summary: Corrected the transfer importer's idempotency check and reconciled the duplicated synthetic summary entries. Verified that replaying an existing event did not change stock totals.

short_description: Stock availability is wrong for items held in inspection
description: The inventory application offers units for sale that are held in an inspection location. Transaction history and bin quantities are correct, and the issue affects only the new inspection status. Other warehouses calculate available quantities normally.
resolution_summary: Updated the availability calculation's location-status mapping to exclude inspection stock. Rebuilt the affected synthetic availability summaries and reconciled them with the bin records.

short_description: Customer service portal loses filters when moving between pages
description: Users selecting a customer category in the service portal see matching results on the first page but unrelated results on the second. The behavior occurs in different browsers and accounts. The server request for page two lacks the selected category parameter.
resolution_summary: Fixed the portal pagination logic to preserve the active filter parameters. Verified consistent results across pages and confirmed that resetting filters restored the full result set.

short_description: Service portal cannot save a case with an optional blank field
description: Creating a case in the service portal fails with a validation error when the optional asset reference is left empty. Entering a valid synthetic asset reference allows submission. Multiple users reproduce the problem, while sign-in and existing case access work normally.
resolution_summary: Corrected the case submission validator to allow an empty optional reference without bypassing validation of supplied values. Verified case creation with and without a synthetic asset reference.

short_description: Finance report counts reversed journal entries as active
description: A finance report total is higher than the source ledger for one reporting period. The difference matches a set of reversed synthetic journals, which remain visible with reversal status in the ledger. Re-running the report from another workstation produces the same total.
resolution_summary: Corrected the report's journal-status filter and regenerated the affected period. Reconciled the output to active ledger entries and verified that reversal history remained accessible.

short_description: Financial period cannot be opened despite completed checks
description: Authorized test accountants cannot open a new reporting period in the finance application. The workflow reports an outstanding prerequisite, while the prerequisite task list shows completion. Other periods remain accessible and the application audit contains no authentication failures.
resolution_summary: Repaired the period workflow's stale completion state after verifying the completed synthetic prerequisites. Opened the approved period and verified posting with a test journal.

short_description: Order totals differ between the entry screen and confirmation
description: A sales order containing a bundled product shows the correct price on entry but a higher total on confirmation. The error is reproducible across browsers and affects only bundles with an optional accessory. Individual products price correctly.
resolution_summary: Corrected the bundle pricing rule that counted the optional accessory twice in the confirmation calculation. Verified matching entry, confirmation, and stored totals for synthetic bundle combinations.

short_description: Order import rejects records containing accented characters
description: An order import rejects synthetic customer names containing accented characters, while plain ASCII records from the same file load successfully. The application import log shows character decoding errors. Interactive entry of the same names works.
resolution_summary: Updated the import job's file encoding configuration to match the approved UTF-8 feed. Retried only the rejected synthetic records and verified their names and order counts without duplicating successful imports.

short_description: HR leave request deducts too many days for part-time staff
description: The HR application deducts a full working week for a synthetic part-time employee's leave request. Their work schedule is present and daily attendance entries look correct. The issue reproduces for the same schedule pattern across accounts and devices.
resolution_summary: Corrected the leave calculation rule to use the employee's assigned working pattern. Recalculated the synthetic leave balance and verified full-time and part-time request examples.

short_description: Asset application refuses to retire equipment with closed work orders
description: The asset management application will not retire a synthetic device because it reports an open maintenance order. All linked work orders display as closed and other devices can be retired. The application audit shows the blocker referencing a previously cancelled work order.
resolution_summary: Corrected the retirement workflow's treatment of cancelled work orders and refreshed the affected asset's workflow state. Verified retirement of the synthetic asset while confirming that genuinely open maintenance orders still blocked retirement.
